blue_rationale: Kill the raid->held->per-step-coupon pipeline that lets Red convert one steal into ~50 future reward (and Blue into −50). Zeroing the holding reward and seed inventory makes raid loot strictly worthless beyond the capacity cap; raising raid_cost to 2.0 and dropping success prob to 0.15 makes any residual raid attempt strictly negative-EV, restoring the maximin floor that the rotating cooperator already attains in self-play.
